data.name: IdempotencyKeyInvalid
data.value: The Idempotency-Key header is not valid. Use 1 to 255 letters, digits, dots, colons, hyphens or underscores.

data.name: IdempotencyKeyReused
data.value: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request. Use a new key for a new request.

data.name: IdempotencyRequestInProgress
data.value: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Try again shortly.

data.name: IdempotencyResponseNotStored
data.value: The first response to this Idempotency-Key was not stored, so it cannot be repeated. Check the result of the original request.
